id.description: The badge's identity; awards reference it. Never reuse an id.

name.description: What the badge is called. A per-workshop badge shows "<name>: <workshop title>".

description.description: What earning it means, in one or two sentences.

kind.description: Automatic badges are awarded by the platform; manual ones by an officer.

repeatable.description: True when it can be awarded again (shown as a multiplier); false for a one-time achievement.

perWorkshop.description: True when there is one badge per workshop definition rather than one overall.

title: DevDogs badges
description: The badges members can hold and how each is awarded (Backstage packages/events).
